text: Yes, funds in Albert Cash are eligible for FDIC insurance of up to $250,000 on a pass-through basis. Albert isn't a bank, so your money is held in a pooled account at Sutton Bank or Stride Bank, N.A., both Members FDIC. The insurance only protects you if one of those banks fails, and it's subject to conditions being met, including that your card is registered. For details, see fdic.gov/deposit/deposits/prepaid.html.
